prompt: I'm writing unit tests for my Python service that uses GLIDE. Show me how to properly mock the GlideClient for testing. My service is in a file called cache_service.py and imports GlideClient at the top.

assertions.name: Mocks at usage location
assertions.description: Should mock at 'cache_service.GlideClient' (usage location), not 'glide_sync.GlideClient' (definition location)

assertions.name: Uses AsyncMock for async methods
assertions.description: Should use AsyncMock (not MagicMock) for async operations

assertions.name: Mocks context manager
assertions.description: Should mock __aenter__ and __aexit__ for async with support

assertions.name: Mocks create() class method
assertions.description: Should mock the create() class method that returns the client instance
